document.title: Evict atlas pages between frames; Korean fallback with block-gated lazy loads
document.summary: Glyphs that find no atlas room draw as an outlined box with a one-time warning, and Noto Sans KR joins the fallback chain behind lazy fonts that open only for their Unicode blocks. Fallback glyphs now rasterise at the requested font's em size.
document.why: A frame needing more glyphs than four pages hold silently skipped the extra glyphs [#92](source:s1), and Korean rendered as missing-glyph boxes while stray codepoints loaded the 4 MB CJK font for nothing [#95](source:s2).

sources.title: Glyph atlas: a frame needing more glyphs than four pages hold never draws the extra glyphs
sources.gist: Overflow glyphs are skipped silently; evict LRU between frames or fail loudly; add a harness case.

sources.title: Fonts: Korean Hangul fallback and avoiding the 4 MB CJK load for stray codepoints
sources.gist: Add a Hangul fallback subset, gate lazy loads by Unicode block, extend the harness and smoke line.

lookFor: Done differently: [#95](source:s2) proposes a subset limited to the 11,172 syllables; the build downloads noto-cjk's prebuilt Korean SubsetOTF (4,644,748 bytes) because cutting it would need a font tool at build time.

Done differently: [#95](source:s2) gates the CJK font on Hangul too; `vd_in_cjk_blocks` leaves Hangul syllables out because Droid Sans Fallback Full has 3 of 11,172, so Korean text opens only Noto Sans KR.

[#92](source:s1) offers LRU eviction between frames; `atlas_allocate` already cleared the least recently used page not used this frame, so this change adds only the box, the warning and the harness cases.

parts.name: Atlas overflow
parts.summary: Glyphs with no atlas room this frame draw as a box and log one warning per run.

parts.name: Korean fallback
parts.summary: Noto Sans KR downloads at configure time and loads on the first Hangul miss; lazy fonts open only for their blocks.

groups.title: Overflow glyphs draw a box and warn once
groups.why: Overflow glyphs drew nothing and logged nothing [#92](source:s1).
groups.summary: `rasterise` and `rasterise_emoji` return the glyph's box with `page` -1 and count it in `overflowed`, which `text_upload_pages` warns about once and `text_draw` outlines.
lookFor: An emoji with no room returns `color` false, so its box is tinted with the text colour like other overflow boxes.
The warning flag lives in `text.c` and survives `text_reset`, so a package switch does not warn again.

groups.title: Lazy fallback fonts gated by Unicode block
groups.why: Stray codepoints opened the 4 MB CJK font even though the glyph stayed missing [#95](source:s2).
groups.summary: `glyph_cache_set_lazy_fonts` replaces the single loader with up to two `VdLazyFont`s, and `resolve_glyph` opens each only when its `covers` predicate accepts the codepoint; `fonts.c` wires Droid to `vd_in_cjk_blocks` and Noto Sans KR to `vd_in_hangul_blocks`.
lookFor: An emoji without an image above U+1F000 no longer opens Droid Sans Fallback Full when looking for its first character, because `glyph_cache_get_emoji` now goes through the same gated `resolve_glyph`.

groups.title: Fallback glyphs at the requested font's em size
groups.why: Noto Sans KR's tall line metrics drew Hangul at 80% of the surrounding DejaVu Sans text.
groups.summary: `glyph_scale` keeps `stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight` for the requested font and gives a fallback source the same em in pixels, and `glyph_cache_get` passes that scale to `rasterise`.
lookFor: Behavior change no ticket asks for: Droid Sans Fallback Full glyphs grow about 12% (18.3 to 20.6 px em at size 24), visible in the golden's CJK line.
The harness now checks a fallback ideograph is as wide as DejaVu Sans' em dash and a Noto syllable 0.92 of it, instead of comparing against the fallback font requested directly.

groups.title: Noto Sans KR download, smoke line and docs
groups.why: The Korean font ships like the other runtime fonts: downloaded, pinned and hash-checked, with its licence tracked [#95](source:s2).
groups.summary: `cmake/fonts.cmake` fetches the font into `VITADECK_RUNTIME_FONTS`, which the VPK and `upload_vita` already loop over, while the smoke line, golden and glossary show 한글.

commits.subject: feat(fonts): Korean fallback; lazy fonts open only for their Unicode blocks
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Noto Sans KR Regular (the noto-cjk Sans2.004 Korean subset build, 4,644,748 bytes, OFL) downloads at configure time, pinned by commit and SHA-256, and follows Droid Sans Fallback Full in the chain. Each lazy fallback now carries the blocks it is opened for: the CJK font for ideographs, kana, CJK symbols, fullwidth forms and jamo, the Korean font for Hangul. A codepoint outside them, like private use, goes straight to the missing-glyph box without loading 4 MB. Hangul syllables skip the CJK font, which has 3 of 11,172.

Fallback glyphs now rasterise at the requested font's em size instead of each font's own line height, which drew Noto Sans KR at 80% and Droid Sans Fallback Full at 89% of DejaVu Sans' em. The smoke line adds 한글 and the Linux golden is refreshed; the CJK glyphs in it grow to match.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(ui): glyphs with no atlas room draw a box and warn once
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The atlas already clears the least recently used page between frames and never one the current frame draws from, so a frame needing more glyphs than four pages hold skipped the rest silently. Those glyphs now carry their bitmap box and text_draw outlines it in the text colour; the first such frame logs one warning per run. The harness checks the box, the per-frame overflow count, and that repeating an overflowing frame rasterises nothing again.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
